title: DataraGrammarAndSyntaxRules
description: Full grammar constructs, string templates, pipeline patterns, and AST productions.

plain_strings.behavior: 100% pure literal string. Braces are NEVER interpolated.
plain_strings.rule: Do not expect {var} to expand in standard quotes.

interpolated_templates.behavior: Zero-allocation Stream Fusion compiles expression directly into destination buffer.
interpolated_templates.rule: Always prefix with 'fmt', '$', or 'f' when referencing variables.

function_declarations.expression_body: fn calculate(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int => a + b
function_declarations.pure_annotation: pure fn add(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int => a + b

pipeline_syntax.rule: Both lower to identical Evidence Gate pipeline IR. 'flow' keyword is only a pipeline stage marker.

try_unpack.behavior: Unpacks value on success; immediately executes early return on Outcome/Maybe failure.

fallback.behavior: Evaluates left; if error or none, returns right-hand fallback expression.

bitwise_rules.diagnostic: Lone '&' and '|' are illegal. Compiler suggests '&&', '||', or '|>'.

comptime_block.behavior: Evaluated during AST expansion and constant folded directly into AST literal

derive_attribute.behavior: Synthesizes to_string, to_json, from_json, hash, and clone methods
